title: Surviving a Tornado: What You Need to Know About Insurance and Repairs
description:
Surviving a Tornado: What You Need to Know About Insurance and Repairs

In this video, I share my personal experience with the aftermath of a tornado that hit my neighborhood. While I wasn’t home during the storm, my house—and my entire community—faced significant damage.

From dealing with three different insurance companies for three separate properties, to navigating contractors and repair quotes, I learned some valuable lessons that could help you if you're ever in a similar situation.

I'll cover:
- How insurance companies assess damage differently
- Why you should never reveal your insurance payout to contractors
- The importance of checking credentials before hiring any contractors
- How to take advantage of this time to make home improvements

Whether you’re dealing with storm damage or just want to be prepared, this video offers tips that could save you time, money, and headaches. Watch and share if you know someone who could benefit from this information!
